result.title: Guided-RLVR: Guided Exploration in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
result.summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has shown strong empirical gains in improving the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs) on tasks such as mathematics and programming. However, recent studies have shown that RLVR rollouts often collapse onto a narrow set of reasoning trajectories, limiting the explored reasoning space. Motivated by findings that thinking tokens at critical steps serve as critical structural elements in LLM reasoning pathways, we propose Guided-RLVR, a novel approach that augments RLVR with a lightweight controller. The controller strategically injects semantically meaningful steering tokens into the sampling distribution, encouraging the model to approach problems from multiple reasoning perspectives and thereby expanding the exploration space. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks show that Guided-RLVR consistently outperforms existing RLVR methods while producing more diverse reasoning trajectories.

AI.brief_summary: 针对 RLVR 采样轨迹易坍缩到少数推理路径的问题，该文提出 Guided-RLVR，用一个轻量控制器向采样分布中注入有语义的引导 token，促使模型从多种推理视角解题，在数学推理与代码生成上报告了更好的性能与更高的轨迹多样性。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本 RLVR 工作，但「在关键步骤注入引导 token 以扩展探索」可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的轨迹多样化与探索监督提供借鉴线索，是否可迁移到多模态需核查。
